title: Dependency context by role
summary: A companion to the internal-module map. Internal consumers and 19 direct external package names are grouped into five roles, rather than drawing 102 arrows. Select a role for every declaring manifest, dependency/dev/peer/optional kind, and requested version. This includes root tooling and the public distribution manifest; it is not a transitive dependency inventory.
